sloka: विस्मयं ते परं गत्वा शत्रुघ्नमिदमब्रुवन् ।साधु पृच्छ नरश्रेष्ठ वाल्मीकिं मुनिपुङ्गवम् ।। ७.७१.२१ ॥
transliteration: vismayaṁ te paraṁ gatvā śatrughnamidamabruvan ।sādhu pṛccha naraśreṣṭha vālmīkiṁ munipuṅgavam ।। 7.71.21 ॥

translations.english: Filled with great astonishment, they said to Shatrughna, "O best among men, please properly ask Valmiki, the foremost among sages."
